subject: ds() not working on models with adjustment terms and convert_units

messages.author: 5f1021d60e6f5e2c
messages.subject: ds() not working on models with adjustment terms and convert_units
parts:
Upon running an example analysis from the link provided (http://examples.distancesampling.org/Distance-cameratraps/camera-distill.html), I got an error within the "Detection function fits" section. The error seems to be related to the incapability of the 'ds()' function to include the adjustment term and convert_units during the process.


I would greatly appreciate any assistance in identifying and addressing this issue. For context, I'm using R version 4.1.0 and Distance package version 1.0.4 in my current environment. Thanks.


-------------------------------

> library(Distance)
> trunc.list <- list(left=2, right=15)
> mybreaks <- c(seq(2,8,1), 10, 12, 15)
> conversion <- convert_units("meter", NULL, "square kilometer")
> uni1 <- ds(DuikerCameraTraps, transect = "point", key="unif", adjustment = "cos",
+            nadj=1, convert_units = conversion,
+            cutpoints = mybreaks, truncation = trunc.list)
Error in ds(DuikerCameraTraps, transect = "point", key = "unif", adjustment = "cos",  :
  unused arguments (nadj = 1, convert_units = conversion)
> uni2 <- ds(DuikerCameraTraps, transect = "point", key="unif", adjustment = "cos",
+            nadj=2, convert_units = conversion,
+            cutpoints = mybreaks, truncation = trunc.list)
Error in ds(DuikerCameraTraps, transect = "point", key = "unif", adjustment = "cos",  :
  unused arguments (nadj = 2, convert_units = conversion)
> uni3 <- ds(DuikerCameraTraps, transect = "point", key="unif", adjustment = "cos",
+            nadj=3, convert_units = conversion,
+            cutpoints = mybreaks, truncation = trunc.list)
Error in ds(DuikerCameraTraps, transect = "point", key = "unif", adjustment = "cos",  :
  unused arguments (nadj = 3, convert_units = conversion)
>

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] ds() not working on models with adjustment terms and convert_units
parts:
Lukmann

Thank you for providing the versions of R and the Distance​ package you are using when describing the error you received.

The example analysis you are running uses arguments for the ds()​ function that were revised in August 2021 with the release of version 1.0.5 of the Distance​ package. Here is an excerpt from the News​ associated with release 1.0.5:

  • To improve consistency in functions and arguments in the package, some functions and arguments have changed from . separation to _. An error is now thrown when the "old" arguments/functions using . are used. This error will be removed in Distance 1.0.6.
  • create.bins() -> create_bins()
  • bootdht():
  • convert.units -> convert_units
  • ds():
  • dht.group -> dht_group
  • region.table -> region_table
  • sample.table -> sample_table
  • obs.table -> obs_table
  • convert.units -> convert_units
  • er.var -> er_var
  • debug.level -> debug_level
  • initial.values -> initial_values
  • max.adjustments -> max_adjustments
  • fix bootdht issue when cluster results were requests (#103)
  • improve flatfile documentation (thanks to Maggie Blake for pointing this out)
  • fixed bug in cutpoint calculations in create.bins (#108)
  • order argument to ds() is now only used to specify order, to fix a given number of adjustments use the new argument nadj (see ?ds for more info)
You will need to update your version of the Distance​ package  (current version is 1.0.8) to be consistent with the syntax used in the example analysis.

messages.author: 5f1021d60e6f5e2c
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] ds() not working on models with adjustment terms and convert_units
parts:
Hi Eric,

I've updated the package, and now it's running properly.

Regarding the code snippet provided below, do you have an estimate of the approximate time it takes to complete? I attempted to run it on 11 cores, but even after four hours, it hadn't finished.

daytime.boot.uni <- bootdht(model=uni3, flatfile=DuikerCameraTraps, resample_transects = TRUE, nboot=500, cores = 11, summary_fun=mysummary, sample_fraction = samfrac, convert_units = conversion, multipliers=mult)

Cheers,
Lukmann

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] ds() not working on models with adjustment terms and convert_units
parts:
Lukmann

Please to hear you have solved one of your problems. Regarding the computing time needed to bootstrap camera trap data, we have made some enhancements to the software to resolve that problem.

If you have updated the packages to Distance 1.0.8​ you will experience an improvement in computing speed if you follow the instructions shown in this case study on our website:

http://examples.distancesampling.org/mcds-dot-exe/mcds-dot-exe.html
Alternative optimization engine for fitting detection functions
Examples demonstrating the use of the mcds.exe alternative optimization engine for fitting single platform detection functions in the Distance and mrds packages.
examples.distancesampling.org


Specifically, if you look at the camera trap example in the case study above

https://examples.distancesampling.org/mcds-dot-exe/mcds-dot-exe.html#camera-trap-example
Alternative optimization engine for fitting detection functions
Examples demonstrating the use of the mcds.exe alternative optimization engine for fitting single platform detection functions in the Distance and mrds packages.
examples.distancesampling.org

you will see a 10-fold reduction in execution time in fitting a detection function to the duiker data set you are working with.  If you have any difficulty with the setup to make use of this more efficient detection fitting scheme, please let us know.
